title: Allahu Shafi Be Haqqil Hussain
body:
Allah,, Allah, Allah
Allaho Shafi Allaho Kafi
Sadqay May Maula Hussain Kay
Ho Koi Maraz Ya Koi Bala
<<DIVIDER>>
Kaam Ayegi Bas Yeh Hi Sada
Weran Thi Zamin E Karbobala
Shabbir Ka Khoon Jab Is May Mila
Yeh Khaak Bani Phir Khaak E Shifa
<<DIVIDER>>
Is Khaak Pe Wajib Hay Sajda
Deta Hay Sada Yeh Ashoora
Mola Ki Zamanat May Dey Key
Hum Say Yeh Kaha Hay Maaoun Nay
<<DIVIDER>>
Hum Khalq Huey Is Gham Ky Liye
Shabbir Ka Matam Kr Beta
Jee Chahye Jitna Khoon Baha
Zakhmo Say Badan Sab Choor Hua
<<DIVIDER>>
Lab Per Na Shikayat Hay Na Gilaa
Hay Dard Yahan Per Misley Dawa
Yeh Sirf Bahatter (72) Per Hy Khola
Shabbir Pey Mar Jana Hay Shifa
<<DIVIDER>>
Hussain Haey Hussain Shah Hussain
Haey Akber
Seene May Lagi Jis Dam Barchi
Medaan May Qaza Bhi Roney Lagi
<<DIVIDER>>
Zainab Pey Qayamat Toot Gai
Akber Ney Jigar Ko Thaam Liya
Behtey Huey Khoon Ney Di Yeh Sada
Haey Asghar....
<<DIVIDER>>
Jis Wakt Galay Per Teer Laga
Tha Maa Kay Laboun Per Shukr E Khuda
Bano Nay Dar E Khaymaa Say Kaha
Yeh Teer Nikalynge Baba
<<DIVIDER>>
Ghabrana Nahi Asghar Beta
Sakeena Haey Sakina...
Halaat Ajab Thay Ghurbat Kay
Rukhsar Thay Neelay Bachi Kay
<<DIVIDER>>
Gohar Bhi Laeen Nay Cheen Liye
Kano Say Laho Jab Behne Laga
Zainab Nay Sakina Say Yeh Kaha
Qurban Takallum Ho Us Per
<<DIVIDER>>
Sajjad Ka Tha Yeh Zakhm E Jigar
Maa Behne Phopi Thi Be Chadar
Bazar May Khoon Bhi Rota Raha Aur Zakhmi Laboon Say Kehta Raha
Haey Haey Shaam
<<DIVIDER>>
Haey Haey Shaam
Karbala Kay Baad Bhi Tum Syed E Sajjad Ho
Dosra Hota To Keh Deta Khuda Koi Nahi
